# clavis admin shamir split

<p class="cli-lead">Split the root key into threshold shares</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin shamir split [flags]
```

</div>

Split the root key into `--shares` pieces, any `--threshold` of which rebuild it. `--seal` removes the root key, so the server won't start until unsealed.

## Examples

```sh
clavis admin shamir split --shares 5 --threshold 3 --out ./shares --seal --yes
```

</dl>

## Details

Shares are as sensitive as the root key. Store them offline, with different people.
